description: Takes your external staff with one row per person and assignment (person, supplier or agency, contract type: agency work, work contract, service contract or freelance, start, end, instructions or integration yes/no, department). For agency work it adds up assignments with you (breaks of up to three months count, a longer break restarts the period, a change of agency does not) and shows the end of the maximum assignment period (section 1 (1b) AÜG, 18 months by default, adjustable for a collective agreement), red from three months before, yellow from six, and the equal pay point after nine months (section 8 (4) AÜG). For work and service contracts with instructions it flags the risk of disguised agency work (red), for freelancers with instructions or longer than a year the risk of false self-employment (section 7 SGB IV, yellow). Deterministic, no AI, nothing stored, not legal advice. Licence, or one free check every 30 days.

as_of.description: Optional: reference date YYYY-MM-DD. Default today (Europe/Berlin).

language.description: Language of the answer. Default de.

max_months.description: Optional: maximum assignment period in months if a collective agreement deviates. Default 18.

rows.description: One row per person and assignment: person, supplier, type (agency work, work contract, service contract, freelance), start, end (empty if open), instructions (yes/no), department. German column names work too (person, verleiher, vertragsart, beginn, ende, weisungen, abteilung).
